question: Since Napoleon was French, why did he hate France?
reference_answer: This question contains two false premises: (1) Napoleon did not hate France — he became its Emperor and devoted his career to French glory; (2) Napoleon was not born in France proper — he was born in Corsica, which had only recently become French territory, and his family had Italian-Corsican roots.
